content:
As the EU's new transparency regulations for AI-generated content come into effect, WhatsApp is developing a new feature that will allow channel administrators to label certain types of AI-generated content. Here are the details.

"Channel administrators in your country/region must label channel updates that use AI content"

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing a new feature that will allow channel administrators to mark certain types of content as AI-generated.

References to the new feature have appeared in the latest WhatsApp Android beta version, but since the feature appears designed in response to regulatory requirements in specific countries, an iOS version and broader rollout are expected later.

According to the report, the new feature will follow the same process used by channel administrators when posting sponsored content:

WABetaInfo points out that not all AI-generated content must be labelled. Based on the current splash screen description, AI content includes images, videos, or other media created or edited using AI tools.

In other words, administrators do not appear to need to label AI-generated text content. It is not yet clear whether this option will be rolled out globally or only made available in regions where the law requires such labelling.
